items.title: Foreign Portfolio Investors Withdraw Substantial Capital from Domestic Equities
items.summary: Overseas funds pulled over forty-five thousand crore rupees from domestic shares during the opening six sessions of the month. Rising American sovereign bond yields and elevated energy costs fueled this sustained withdrawal.
items.why: Tracking foreign institutional activity helps beginners understand cross-border capital flows and global drivers affecting domestic share valuations.

items.title: Electric Vehicle Manufacturer Finalizes One Thousand Crore Rupee Capital Raise
items.summary: Ola Electric scheduled a rights offering to raise fresh capital by issuing additional shares at twenty-seven rupees each. Current equity holders on the mid-October eligibility cut-off date receive entitlements based on their holdings.
items.why: Rights issues provide an avenue for listed firms to raise capital directly from existing owners without diluting them externally.

items.title: Central Bank Creates Dedicated Dollar Facility for State Oil Refiners
items.summary: The Reserve Bank established a targeted exchange conduit providing foreign currency directly to three public fuel marketing enterprises. This mechanism fulfills their daily import requirements to preserve stability across local foreign exchange channels.
items.why: Direct foreign exchange supply prevents high-volume fuel import transactions from triggering sharp fluctuations in the local currency.

items.title: Reserve Bank Initiates Open Market Sale of Sovereign Securities
items.summary: The monetary authority scheduled an open market operation auctioning government debt papers valued at twenty-five thousand crore rupees. This intervention was organized after evaluating evolving domestic cash conditions.
items.why: Selling state securities enables the monetary authority to absorb excess money from the banking system to regulate financial liquidity.

items.title: Major Domestic Benchmarks Halt Multi-Week Downturn via Tech Rally
items.summary: The Nifty and Sensex completed their recent trading week higher, breaking an unbroken two-month succession of weekly declines. Buying support across software technology firms helped propel the wider market rebound.
items.why: Broad index movements illustrate overarching market sentiment and indicate which industry groups are leading cyclical recoveries.

items.title: Precious Metals Trade Within Defined Bands Amid Currency Shifts
items.summary: Gold and silver experienced contained price action as weakness in the home currency lent baseline support to domestic rates. Market watchers noted that overseas rate factors balanced local pricing momentum.
items.why: Because bullion is priced globally in foreign currency, changes in foreign exchange rates directly alter domestic import parity prices.
